project.name: RepoChan
project.description: Turn a git repository into a full brand kit — mascot persona, illustrations, stickers, posters and a landing page — via a CLI + agent pipeline.

brand.artStyle: Constructivist propaganda poster wall — industrial geometry, a strictly limited red/black/cream palette (gray secondary, blue on exactly one poster), full-bleed posters with hard cuts between screens, slogans as composition, and the character subordinated to geometry as a flat silhouette symbol.
